doc.title: Tony Parenti and Anthony Sbarbaro Interview, 1959-06-29

title: Millenburg pavilions, camp picnics, Roppolo's breakdown and the fish fry
summary: Playing soft at Millenburg pavilions, battle-of-music camp jobs, Roppolo's first signs of illness, a later vacation camp, and the Claiborne Street fish fry.
